carpet.rule.autoDrop.name: Dummy Player Shulker Box Drop
carpet.rule.autoDrop.desc: Enables /player <name> autodrop and cactus left-click triggers. Scans dummy player inventories for shulker boxes and drops boxes containing only a single type of item.
carpet.rule.bonemealSporeBlossom.name: Bonemeal Spore Blossom
carpet.rule.bonemealSporeBlossom.desc: Using bonemeal on a spore blossom generates new spore blossoms.
carpet.rule.torchflowerDropSeeds.name: Torchflower Seed Drops
carpet.rule.torchflowerDropSeeds.desc: Breaking a torchflower additionally drops 1–3 torchflower seeds.
carpet.rule.cactusOxidizeCopper.name: Cactus Oxidizes Copper
carpet.rule.cactusOxidizeCopper.desc: Right-clicking a copper block with a cactus advances it to the next oxidation stage.
carpet.rule.batchPlayerCommand.name: Batch Player Command
carpet.rule.batchPlayerCommand.desc: Enables the /playerManager batch <prefix> <start> <end> <action> command for batch spawning, killing, and controlling dummy players with Carpet action packs.
carpet.rule.playerInventoryStack.name: Custom Player Inventory Stack Size
carpet.rule.playerInventoryStack.desc: Allows /playerInventoryStack to customize the maximum stack size of items in player inventories. Dropped items and other containers retain vanilla behavior.
carpetodd.command.playerInventoryStack.e: No inventory stack rules are currently set
carpetodd.command.playerInventoryStack.f: Filled Shulker Box: a shulker box where all 27 slots are filled to the vanilla maximum stack size of their respective items
